doc: A job registration whose resource header names a job the body does not hold (FBL 0.10, sections 7.4 and 8.2; spec 066, edge case 13): the reading opens empty and says why, with fbl.missing-resource at the header's line of the registration; the body is not unreadable. Its body, two-jobs-two-pipelines.yml, is etalii.adp.ide.standalone's src/diagrams/databricks/backend/EtAlii.Adp.Diagram.Databricks.Tests/Fixtures/two-jobs-two-pipelines.yml at ad1a4680a, byte for byte (CRLF).

steps.doc: Adding a task to the job the header names, which the body does not hold, is refused: there is no tasks section to add into, and the binding gives that sentence (refusals.container, section 6.4).
steps.refused: The job has no tasks section to add into.
